from qiskit.optimization.initial_guess import UniformInitialGuess
from scipy.optimize import minimize
import dimod
import neal

def euclidean_distance(coords1, coords2):
    return np.sqrt(np.sum((coords1 - coords2) ** 2))

def create_interference_graph(coordinates):
    G = nx.Graph()
    for i, (x1, y1) in enumerate(coordinates):
        for j, (x2, y2) in enumerate(coordinates):
            if i != j and euclidean_distance([x1, y1], [x2, y2]) <= 1.5:
                G.add_edge(coordinates[i], coordinates[j])
    return G

    G.add_edges_from(graph_edges)

    qc = QuantumCircuit(len(G), len(G))

    # QAOA Ansatz
    driver = QuantumCircuit(len(G), 1)
    for i in range(len(G)):
        driver.x(i)
    ansatz = QAOAAnsatz(p=p_layers, driver=driver, transpile=transpile)
    ansatz.construct_graph(qc_graph)

    # Initialize noise model
    noiseless_noise_model = NoiseModel()
    backend = Aer.get_backend('qasm_simulator')

    # Define the QAOA cost function and constraint
    def cost_func(params):
        qc.bind_parameters(params)
        qc.measure_all()
        job = execute(qc, backend=backend, shots=opt_shots, noise_model=noiseless_noise_model)
        result = job.result()
        count = result.get_counts(qc)
        energy = min(count[k] for k in count if known_reference_partition in k)
        return -energy

    def constraint_func(params):
        qc.bind_parameters(params)
        qc.measure_all()
        job = execute(qc, backend=backend, shots=opt_shots, noise_model=noiseless_noise_model)

        count = result.get_counts(qc)
        num_interfering_pairs = sum(count[k] for k in count if len(set(k) & set(known_reference_partition)) == 2)
        return num_interfering_pairs

    initial_guess = UniformInitialGuess(p_layers)
    algo = QuantumApproximateOptimizationAlgorithm(cost_func, constraint_func, initial_guess, maxiter=maxiter, optimizer="L-BFGS-B", seed_initial_points=seed)
